text:
Maya (partnerships): CircuitHub wants to list a community model bundle on our marketplace. Need quick alignment on redistribution, packaging, and embargo. Can legal + eng weigh in?
Elise (legal): High level: confirm redistribution rights (download vs serve-only), geo limits, export classification, and attribution text. I'll prepare a 1-page addendum template.
Jon (product): Product requires a tiny manifest + provenance. Prefer fields: model_id, version, artifact_type, quant, weights_sha256, provenance_url. Also need marketplace tile copy (<=200 chars).
Ibrahim (eng-partner): For CI we need: OCI image with /serve entrypoint OR tarball with run.sh, tokenizer file, and a small smoke script. CI checks: checksum, /health -> 200, tokenization parity on 5 prompts. ci-bot can run this.
CircuitHub (partner): We can provide int8 artifacts, provenance.zip (signed), and a 300-sample eval. Request: co-branding and a short embargo until joint press (dates TBD). Also want geoblock for APAC initially.
Elise (legal): Co-branding OK with MOA. Geoblock fine; add explicit territory list in addendum. Add clause: partner represents they have rights to redistribute third-party components.
Maya (partnerships): Timeline proposal: addendum draft by Thu, artifacts uploaded by Mon noon, CI green by Tue. Sound tight but doable?
Jon (product): Sounds good. Add rollback plan: marketplace will mark tile as "paused" and route to our hosted model id if CI fails post-launch.
Ibrahim (eng-partner): I'll wire a minimal orchestrate job and share YAML. Expected exit codes: 0 pass, 1 fail. Will require presigned S3 path.
ci-bot: staging bucket created: s3://redwood-partners/circuithub/1768123456/ (presign link to follow)
CircuitHub (partner): We'll upload artifacts Friday evening. Thanks all.
Maya (partnerships): Action items: Elise draft addendum; Jon draft manifest validator; Ibrahim hook CI; CircuitHub upload. Sync Monday 9am PT.
